'''Antz''' (singular '''ant''') was the term used to refer to any of many insect species of the forest [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]]. They were found in the [[Silver Forest of Dreams]]. The largest species was the [[Silver ant]].
